{ name: "Piranha Pit", time: 55, hint: "Watch the piranha. Push the stone down the shaft as it swims underneath.", tip: "New: piranha. It hunts you once it sees you.", map: [
'################',
'#....   ..   ..#',
'#.......WW....P#',
'#W R.B..WWWWWWW#',
'#W .W.W.WWWWWWW#',
'#W       F    E#',
'#WWWWWWWWWWWWWW#',
'################',
]},
aha: You cannot get past the piranha in its tunnel; push the stone down the side shaft when it swims to the dead end below, then the tunnel is safe for the pearl.
deadlocks: Pushing the stone down the shaft while the piranha is elsewhere: the stone lands in the dead end, the piranha lives on and blocks the tunnel.
Entering the tunnel (or opening the pearl plug) while the piranha is alive: it charges along the clear row.
